notes: No misreadings found. Two citation gaps, where the claims hold but come from facts other than the one cited: /configuration/11 says activePage and totalPages are ignored when children is supplied, but the cited /facts/props/3 says only that children overrides the default page buttons; the 'ignored' wording is in /facts/props/0 and /facts/props/1. /configuration/5 cites only /facts/props/1 (totalPages), while the activePage default of 1 comes from /facts/props/0. Also, /useWhen/1 lifts the In context illustration ('A photo carousel on a product card') into a use-when. It is a fair instance of the summary's 'short media carousel', so it is not flagged. /anatomy/1 and /anatomy/2 are marked alwaysPresent=true even though custom children replace the page buttons; this is minor because the guide does not show children.
